description: Adversary emulation scripts for Microsoft Entra ID detection validation. Designed for Purple Team exercises to validate Microsoft Sentinel analytics rules against Entra ID activity. All scripts require Microsoft Graph PowerShell module and appropriate permissions in a test environment.
author: X3M.AI
prerequisites: Microsoft.Graph PowerShell module installed: Install-Module Microsoft.Graph -Scope CurrentUser

Connected to Microsoft Graph with appropriate permissions: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes 'Group.ReadWrite.All','User.ReadWrite.All','RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory','Policy.ReadWrite.AuthenticationMethod','AuditLog.Read.All' (App Registration requires Directory.ReadWrite.All + Group.ReadWrite.All Application permissions with admin consent)
Test environment only - never run against production identity infrastructure
Global Administrator or equivalent test role required
capabilities: Exercises Entra ID identity changes including group membership, user lifecycle, privileged role assignment, PIM, consent, authentication policy, and token-related activity.
Generates Microsoft Graph and Entra audit telemetry for validating Microsoft Sentinel identity analytics.
Provides focused Scripts and Chains mapped to identity-relevant MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
use_cases: Validate that Entra ID and Microsoft Sentinel detect authorized identity-control abuse scenarios.
Test privileged access monitoring, role and group change alerts, consent governance, and authentication policy controls.
Measure identity-focused ATT&CK coverage during a controlled Purple Team exercise.
safety_notes: Several Scripts modify tenant identity state; use a dedicated test tenant or explicitly approved production exercise.
Use least-privileged test credentials, record all created objects, and verify cleanup after execution.
Never store Microsoft Graph client secrets in package files, source control, or shared logs.

scripts.command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; $tmpFile = 'C:\ProgramData\Morgana\temp\morgana-group-id.tmp'; if (-not (Test-Path $tmpFile)) { Write-Host '[ERROR] Group ID file not found - run Morgana-EntraID-GroupCreate first'; exit 1 }; $groupId = (Get-Content $tmpFile).Trim(); Write-Host "[INFO] Deleting group $groupId"; Remove-MgGroup -GroupId $groupId; Remove-Item $tmpFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep 3; try { Get-MgGroup -GroupId $groupId -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Write-Host '[WARN] Group still visible (soft-delete replication lag - this is expected)' } catch { Write-Host '[SUCCESS] Group deleted - Excalibur-EntraID-Group Deleted should trigger in Sentinel' }

scripts.id: Excalibur - Excalibur-EntraID-Bulk Changes to Privileged Account Permissions
scripts.name: Excalibur - Excalibur-EntraID-Bulk Changes to Privileged Account Permissions
scripts.description: Simulates bulk changes to privileged account permissions. Creates multiple test users and adds them all to a test privileged group in rapid succession to trigger bulk permission change detection.
scripts.command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'; $dom = '#{excalibur_tenant_domain}'; $pp = @{ ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $false; Password = '#{excalibur_test_password}' }; $ids = @(); 1..5 | ForEach-Object { $u = New-MgUser -DisplayName "MorganaTest-BPP-$ts-$_" -UserPrincipalName "morganatest-bpp-$ts-$_@$dom" -AccountEnabled:$false -PasswordProfile $pp -MailNickname "mg-bpp-$ts-$_"; $ids += $u.Id; Write-Host "[INFO] Created user $($u.UserPrincipalName)" }; $grp = New-MgGroup -DisplayName "MorganaTest-PrivGroup-$ts" -MailEnabled:$false -SecurityEnabled:$true -MailNickname "mg-pg-$ts"; do { Start-Sleep 3; $gchk = Get-MgGroup -GroupId $grp.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } until ($gchk -ne $null); $ids | ForEach-Object { $mid=$_; $ok=$false; 1..5 | ForEach-Object { if(!$ok){ try { New-MgGroupMember -GroupId $grp.Id -DirectoryObjectId $mid -ErrorAction Stop; $ok=$true } catch { Start-Sleep 5 } } } }; Write-Host "[SUCCESS] Bulk privilege assignment done - 5 users added to privileged group"; "GRP:$($grp.Id)" | Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\morgana-bpp-$ts.tmp"; $ids -join ',' | Add-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\morgana-bpp-$ts.tmp"
scripts.cleanup_command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; $tmpFiles = Get-ChildItem "$env:TEMP\morgana-bpp-*.tmp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $tmpFiles | ForEach-Object { $lines = Get-Content $_; $grpId = ($lines[0] -split ':')[1]; $userIds = $lines[1] -split ','; $userIds | ForEach-Object { try { Remove-MgUser -UserId $_ -Confirm:$false; Write-Host "[INFO] Removed user $_" } catch {} }; try { Remove-MgGroup -GroupId $grpId -Confirm:$false; Write-Host "[INFO] Removed group $grpId" } catch {}; Remove-Item $_ }; Write-Host "[SUCCESS] Cleanup complete"
scripts.detection_rule: Excalibur-EntraID-Bulk Changes to Privileged Account Permissions

scripts.command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'; $dom = '#{excalibur_tenant_domain}'; $pp = @{ ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $false; Password = '#{excalibur_test_password}' }; $u = New-MgUser -DisplayName "MorganaTest-PwdReset-$ts" -UserPrincipalName "morganatest-pr-$ts@$dom" -AccountEnabled:$false -PasswordProfile $pp -MailNickname "mg-pr-$ts"; Write-Host "[INFO] Created test user: $($u.UserPrincipalName)"; $hdaTmplId = '729827e3-9c14-49f7-bb1b-9608f156bbb8'; $hdaRole = Get-MgDirectoryRole | Where-Object DisplayName -eq 'Helpdesk Administrator'; if (-not $hdaRole) { $hdaRole = New-MgDirectoryRole -BodyParameter @{ roleTemplateId = $hdaTmplId } }; $appSp = Get-MgServicePrincipal -Filter "AppId eq '#{excalibur_client_id}'"; New-MgDirectoryRoleMemberByRef -DirectoryRoleId $hdaRole.Id -BodyParameter @{ '@odata.id' = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directoryObjects/$($appSp.Id)" }; Start-Sleep 5; $newPwd = @{ ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $false; Password = '#{excalibur_reset_password}' }; Update-MgUser -UserId $u.Id -PasswordProfile $newPwd; Remove-MgDirectoryRoleMemberDirectoryObjectByRef -DirectoryRoleId $hdaRole.Id -DirectoryObjectId $appSp.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "[SUCCESS] Password reset performed - Excalibur-TH-UEBA-Anomalous Password Reset should trigger"; $u.Id | Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\morgana-pr-$ts.tmp"
scripts.cleanup_command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; $tmpFiles = Get-ChildItem "$env:TEMP\morgana-pr-*.tmp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $tmpFiles | ForEach-Object { $uid = Get-Content $_; try { Remove-MgUser -UserId $uid -Confirm:$false; Write-Host "[INFO] Removed user $uid" } catch {}; Remove-Item $_ }; Write-Host "[SUCCESS] Cleanup complete"

scripts.name: Excalibur - Excalibur-SigninLogs-Nimbus Logging in Outside The VPN
scripts.description: Simulates a Nimbus service account login from outside the expected VPN IP range. Authenticates using a test Nimbus-named account from the current host to generate a sign-in log entry for VPN compliance detection.
scripts.command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmss'; $dom = '#{excalibur_tenant_domain}'; $pp = @{ ForceChangePasswordNextSignIn = $false; Password = '#{excalibur_test_password}' }; $u = New-MgUser -DisplayName "svc-nimbus-morganatest-$ts" -UserPrincipalName "svc-nimbus-morganatest-$ts@$dom" -AccountEnabled:$true -PasswordProfile $pp -MailNickname "svc-nimbus-mg-$ts"; Write-Host "[INFO] Created Nimbus-named test account: $($u.UserPrincipalName)"; $tenantId = (Get-MgOrganization).Id; $currentIP = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api4.my-ip.io/ip.txt' -UseBasicParsing).Trim(); Write-Host "[INFO] Current IP (simulated outside VPN): $currentIP"; $body = "grant_type=password&username=$($u.UserPrincipalName)&password=#{excalibur_test_password}&client_id=04b07795-8ddb-461a-bbee-02f9e1bf7b46&scope=https://graph.microsoft.com/.default"; try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://login.microsoftonline.com/$tenantId/oauth2/v2.0/token" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'; Write-Host "[SUCCESS] Sign-in from non-VPN IP generated for Nimbus account" } catch { Write-Host "[INFO] Auth result: $($_.Exception.Message.Split('"')[0])" }; Write-Host "[INFO] Excalibur-SigninLogs-Nimbus Logging in Outside The VPN triggered if Conditional Access Named Location is configured"; $u.Id | Set-Content -Path "$env:TEMP\morgana-nimbus-$ts.tmp"
scripts.cleanup_command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; $tmpFiles = Get-ChildItem "$env:TEMP\morgana-nimbus-*.tmp" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $tmpFiles | ForEach-Object { $uid = Get-Content $_; try { Remove-MgUser -UserId $uid -Confirm:$false; Write-Host "[INFO] Removed user $uid" } catch {}; Remove-Item $_ }; Write-Host "[SUCCESS] Cleanup complete"
scripts.detection_rule: Excalibur-SigninLogs-Nimbus Logging in Outside The VPN

scripts.id: Excalibur - Excalibur-EntraIDProtection-Anonymous IP address
scripts.name: Excalibur - Excalibur-EntraIDProtection-Anonymous IP address
scripts.description: Queries current Entra ID Protection risk detections for anonymous IP sign-ins. To fully trigger this detection, authenticate from a Tor exit node or known anonymization proxy while connected. Provides guidance and reads existing risk events.
scripts.command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "[INFO] Querying Entra ID Protection - Anonymous IP risk detections..."; try { $riskDetections = Get-MgRiskDetection -Filter "riskEventType eq 'anonymizedIPAddress'" -Top 5; Write-Host "[INFO] Recent anonymous IP detections: $($riskDetections.Count)"; $riskDetections | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $($_.UserDisplayName) | $($_.IpAddress) | $($_.DetectedDateTime)" }; Write-Host "[INFO] To trigger Excalibur-EntraIDProtection-Anonymous IP address:"; Write-Host "  1. Use Tor Browser or connect through a known anonymous proxy"; Write-Host "  2. Navigate to https://myapps.microsoft.com and authenticate with a test account"; Write-Host "  3. Entra ID Protection detects the anonymous IP and raises a risk event"; Write-Host "  4. Sentinel rule Excalibur-EntraIDProtection-Anonymous IP address fires on the risk event" } catch { Write-Host "[WARN] Could not query risk detections (requires Entra ID P2): $_" }; Write-Host "[INFO] This detection is IP-reputation based - manual simulation from anonymizing network required"
scripts.cleanup_command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "[INFO] No cleanup required - this simulation was informational/read-only. Dismiss any risk events created via Get-MgRiskyUser and Confirm-MgRiskyUserCompromised if needed."

scripts.id: Excalibur - Create incidents based on Microsoft Entra ID Protection alerts
scripts.name: Excalibur - Create incidents based on Microsoft Entra ID Protection alerts
scripts.description: Queries Entra ID Protection for existing risk events and risky users to validate that the Sentinel incident creation rule for Entra ID Protection alerts is operational. Creates a test risky condition by combining multiple risk signals.
scripts.command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "[INFO] Checking Entra ID Protection integration with Microsoft Sentinel..."; try { $riskyUsers = Get-MgRiskyUser | Where-Object { $_.RiskLevel -ne 'none' -and $_.RiskState -ne 'dismissed' } | Select-Object -First 10; Write-Host "[INFO] Active risky users: $($riskyUsers.Count)"; $riskyUsers | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $($_.UserDisplayName) | Risk: $($_.RiskLevel) | State: $($_.RiskState) | Last updated: $($_.RiskLastUpdatedDateTime)" }; $riskDetections = Get-MgRiskDetection | Where-Object { $_.RiskState -eq 'atRisk' } | Select-Object -First 5; Write-Host "[INFO] Active risk detections: $($riskDetections.Count)"; $riskDetections | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  - $($_.UserDisplayName) | Type: $($_.RiskEventType) | $($_.IpAddress)" }; Write-Host "[INFO] Validation: Sentinel rule 'Create incidents based on Microsoft Entra ID Protection alerts' should auto-create incidents from the above events"; Write-Host "[INFO] If no risky users found, run other Excalibur scripts first to generate risk signals, or use Confirm-MgRiskyUserCompromised to manually trigger incident creation" } catch { Write-Host "[WARN] Could not query Entra ID Protection (requires Entra ID P2): $_" }
scripts.cleanup_command: $secSecret = ConvertTo-SecureString '#{excalibur_client_secret}' -AsPlainText -Force; $cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential('#{excalibur_client_id}', $secSecret); Connect-MgGraph -TenantId '#{excalibur_tenant_id}' -ClientSecretCredential $cred -NoWelcome -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "[INFO] To dismiss risk events: $uids | ForEach-Object { Invoke-MgDismissRiskyUser -UserIds @($_) }"; Write-Host "[INFO] Run this manually after validating that Sentinel created the expected incidents"
scripts.detection_rule: Create incidents based on Microsoft Entra ID Protection alerts
